_comment: Model profiles for llama-multimodel-mcp. Copy to ~/.llama-mm/profiles.json (or point config.profiles_file at it). 'tier' drives workflow routing: 'quality' = high-quality executor, 'bulk' = fast/rough executor. provider: 'llama-server' = full lifecycle (start/stop/bench/telemetry); 'openai-compatible' = inference + stats against a running server (LM Studio :1234, Ollama :11434/v1, vLLM, llama-swap, ...).

code-quality.description: High-quality coding executor (tune ctx/args to your VRAM)

bulk-fast.description: Fast/rough executor for mechanical batch work

lmstudio.description: Running LM Studio / Ollama(/v1) / vLLM / llama-swap endpoint
